## Example 4.2 {#iv4-example-4-2 .vector-lesson .magnitude-lesson }

<p>Find the magnitude of the following vectors</p><div class="m-parts"><div class="m-part"><p><strong>a)</strong> <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}=-3\underset{\sim}{i}+4\underset{\sim}{j}"></span></p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="m-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show working</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="|\underset{\sim}{a}|=\sqrt{(-3)^2+4^2}=5"></span></div></div></div></div><div class="m-part"><p><strong>b)</strong> <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}=-5\underset{\sim}{i}-3\underset{\sim}{j}+2\underset{\sim}{k}"></span></p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="m-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show working</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="|\underset{\sim}{b}|=\sqrt{25+9+4}=\sqrt{38}"></span></div></div></div></div><div class="m-part"><p><strong>c)</strong> <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{c}=4\underset{\sim}{j}"></span></p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="m-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show working</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="|\underset{\sim}{c}|=\sqrt{0^2+4^2}=4"></span></div></div></div></div><div class="m-part"><p><strong>d)</strong> <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{d}=\underset{\sim}{i}+2\underset{\sim}{k}"></span></p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="m-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show working</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="|\underset{\sim}{d}|=\sqrt{1^2+0^2+2^2}=\sqrt5"></span></div></div></div></div></div>
<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Example 4.2 · p. 27</div>

::: notes
Answers: a) 5; b) sqrt(38); c) 4; d) sqrt(5). Include brackets around negative components before squaring, and read missing basis-vector terms as zero components. Keep exact surds.
:::
